_source.title: 设置扩展用户配置
_source.remarks.text.0: 新建扩展用户配置也使用本接口，在设置时如果不存在将会自动新建
_source.remarks.text.1: 注意：本接口仅扩展有效，在独立脚本环境内调用将始终 `throw Error`

title: Set Extension user configuration
remarks.text.0: This API is also used to create a new extension user configuration. If it does not exist when setting, it will be created automatically
remarks.text.1: Note: This API is only valid for extensions. Calling it in a standalone script environment will always `throw Error`
